Thomas Cook India and SOTC Launch New Year Travel Packages

Diverse Holiday Offerings for Indian Travelers

Thomas Cook India and SOTC Travel have unveiled a comprehensive series of travel packages tailored for the year-end festive season. These offerings are designed to cater to Indian travelers looking to combine New Year celebrations with immersive experiences across various global and domestic locations.

Destinations and Experiences

The companies announced that their new holiday portfolio covers a wide geographical spread, including:

  • International: Australia, New Zealand, Europe, various Asian countries, and the Middle East.
  • Domestic: A curated selection of destinations within India.
  • Specialty Travel: Expeditions to the Arctic and various ocean cruises.

Booking and Customization Options

According to the announcement, the travel solutions are available in two primary formats:

  1. Air-inclusive Group Tours: These packages typically include transportation, accommodation, and guided excursions for those looking for a structured travel experience.
  2. Customized Itineraries: Designed for travelers seeking personalized plans that cater to specific interests and schedules.

How to Verify Details

Interested travelers can verify the specifics of these year-end packages by visiting the official Thomas Cook India or SOTC Travel websites. It is recommended that customers review the full inclusion lists, cancellation policies, and current visa requirements for their chosen destination before confirming any bookings. Travelers should ensure they consult directly with authorized travel representatives to validate pricing and availability for their preferred travel dates.
